description: In apply_header_form (email.rs line 290), the AsText branch calls unfolded.trim_start().to_string(). trim_start() returns &str; calling .to_string() on &str triggers Clippy's str_to_string lint. The idiomatic replacement is .to_owned(), which makes clear that this is a simple heap allocation rather than a Display-based conversion.
title: email.rs apply_header_form: trim_start().to_string() should be .to_owned()
